description:
an incredibly-creatively-titled sequel to 10 Solid Minutes of Misinformation. This time a bunch of the facts came from viewers, in a livestream I did to take suggestions: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=INZd_vSu_Y4
If this video does well enough, we'll definitely do another stream like that!

also we have a discord if you want to participate in future events: https://discord.gg/xyhAJJJ3Uq

subscribe please, i need to buy more food for the giant talking carnivorous plant living in my shed
